YALLAKKA GOUDRA

Vijayanagar, Bangalore, Pin: 560040. Mobile: 9008983625 E-mail: goudrayallakka@gmail.com

NETWORK ENGINEER

To obtain challenging position in an organization that requires highly motivated and creative people to learn and contribute in a team environment. Looking for a growth oriented work environment for a mutual benefit with an organization.

TECHNICAL SKILLS

Over all 6+ years of experience in the IT industry.

Implementing and supporting Data Centre Operations. Configuring and troubleshooting Cisco routers (1841,7200, ASR 1002,1006),

switches(4509,6513) , Nexus(9504, 7010, 5k, 9300, 3k series) ,Arista, Juniper Worked on

fortigate and Palo alto, firewalls. Configured and maintained Routing protocols such as Static, RIP, EIGRP, OSPF and BGP,

IPSEC, SSL VPN.

Implemented and monitored Switching Protocols: STP,VLAN,VTP,HSRP, VRRP,

EtherChannel

Implemented traffic filters using Standard access-lists, Route Maps, MPLS QOS. Automation Tools: COAX, DCNM, HPNA, EM7, Cisco-Coral

Monitoring Tools: Spectrum, Cisco Prime, solarWinds, and Zabbix. Nexus Switches: 9k, 5k, 7k, 2k,3K and 9504 model

Juniper: MX204, MX480, QFX5120, and QFX5100 Catalyst Switches: 4000 series, 6500, and 3750 POE, 2960x

Routers: ASR1000x ISR , 9481, 3800 model Firewall: Palo alto, Fortigate Ticketing Tools: Remedy, CA-Service-Desk, Helpline, Service-Now, ConnectWise, Myshift,

Jeera

PROFESSIONAL EXPERIENCE

CtrlS Datacenter

August 2025 - Present Senior Engineer Network and Security

Supporting Cisco Data centre across globe Handling on Incidents and troubleshooting and supporting Datacentre issues and implementations. Monitoring customer internet and WAN links and check if any link is down or unstable Verifying interface utilization, errors and packet drops to find performance issue

Creating and implementing configuration scripts for customer deployments on Juniper, Cisco, and Arista devices (BGP,Static routes,HA, route map,ACL) Handling network troubleshooting calls with clients. Conducting KT sessions for junior engineers on network diagrams and daily WAN operations This profile includes design participations with customers, performing HLD,LLD Creating and troubleshooting Fortigate firewall rules

Prodapt Private ltd - AT &T

August 2024 - July 2025 Network engineer

Working on Network migrations/implementations for worldwide AT & T customers Working remotely and supporting the AT & T customers across the globe Handling client interactions through Cisco Finesse, managing email communications, daily assigned

tasks, and performing pre-checks and post-checks for ongoing network activities

Familiar with network security -Paloalto, and FortiGate 3000D devices Supporting to the customers on– Security and Datacentre services. Worked for individual projects- Cisco Datacentre Nexus migrations, IOS patching devices for across in the globe. Involving the client meetings- leading in front of the escalations matric. Working on Nexus 7k, 9k, Cisco 7613 and 6500 Series. NXOS & IOS upgrade for cisco switches and routers.

Capgemini Private ltd - IBM

September 2022 - July 2024 Network engineer

Supporting Cisco Data centre across globe Handling on Incidents and troubleshooting and supporting Datacentre issues and implementations. Active participant in DC Migrations, Implementations. Working on Paloalto-panorama & Fortigate firewalls, creating and implementing firewall rules Creating HA configuration, NAT rules Direct interaction with customers and attending Customer call/auditing projects. Responsible for all changes in routing and switching related to Data centre. Preparing POA & Roll Back plan for new activities and changes. Preparing SOP and other process related documents to streamline the process. Part of transition team of data canter. URL filtering on Checkpoint firewall. NXOS & IOS upgrade for cisco switches and routers. Working on Nexus 7k, 9k, Cisco 7613 and 6500 Series. Troubleshooting and incident handling for all Level-2 issues and involving with TAC.

IDC Technologies- WIPRO LTD September 2021 - August 2022 Network Engineer

Implementing and supporting Cisco Data Center Operations and DC DRILL activities Provide 24x7 Technical Supports for Trane technology NOC, Network Monitoring, supporting.

Active participant in DC Migrations, Implementations. Monitor network health (latency, packet loss, RTO, link flaps) across core, distribution, and edge segments. Troubleshooting and incident handling for all Level-1 issues and involving with TAC. Responsible for all changes in routing and switching related to Data center. Preparing CR, POA & Roll Back plan for new activities and changes. Perform first-level diagnostics on interface down issues, BGP session down, and device reachability problems. Execute basic commands on Juniper, Arista, and Cisco devices to check interface status, errors, and operational state. Working on ITIL management process on reactive and proactive tickets.

Man Power pvt ltd: Orange Business Services pvt ltd. May 2017 - October 2018 Network Engineer

Worked on 24/7 Team for HCL’s LAN, WAN infra networks. Provide 24x7 Technical Supports for British Telecom P&G NOC, Network Monitoring, supporting. Spectrum, HP NA, Cisco works tool monitoring experience. Hands on experience on below devices • Router - 7200, 3800, 2600, 2500 Series. Switches - Cisco Catalyst L2 & L3 - 6500, 4500, 3750, and 2950 Configuration and troubleshooting knowledge on Wireless technology. Switching STACK connectivity, VLAN VTP, DC LINK extending, cable patching supports. Managing all location network assets, Cisco VOIP IP segments, and VLAN and switch port security managements. Configuring Location CISCO Network devices, CISCO VOIP (7942/7940) Switch’s (Catalyst 4000, POE-3750g series switches) Monitoring & initial troubleshooting of Network devices and Servers. Helpline call handling and raising Change requests (RFC) for carrying out network level changes. Ensure scheduled and unscheduled IOS upgrades and Network backups.

PROFESSIONAL CERTIFICATION

Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA) Palo alto PCNSE certified on July 12, 2024 valid till July 12, 2026 ITIL v3 Course completed: CCNP, Fortinet NSE4

EDUCATION

BE in Computer Science, Visvesvaraya Technological University, 2016 PUC in Science (PCMB), Pre-University Education SSLC from state board of Karnataka
